translations.web: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
translations.bsb: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you?
translations.kjv: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
translations.asv: Is it for thy fear of him that he reproveth thee, That he entereth with thee into judgment?
